name: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp.
description: Nevada Canyon Gold Corp. is a junior exploration company with a business model centred on mineral royalty creation, precious-metals streaming and financing, and an exploration project accelerator focused on Nevada and Idaho. The company holds royalty interests and an earn-in agreement at the Lapon Canyon Project in the Walker Lane gold trend. The company is pre-resource stage and targeting a maiden NI 43-101 resource estimate.
